# uzc_isos (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud ISO images.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_isos" "all" {}

output "iso_slugs" {
  value = [for i in data.uzc_isos.all.isos : i.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `isos` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--isos))

### Nested Schema for `isos`

Read-Only:

- `operating_system` (String)
- `operating_system_version` (String)
- `slug` (String) Use this as `iso` where an ISO slug is needed.
